tonight.headline: Two byes in your lineup
body: Bad news first. Golden and the Rams D/ST are on bye and both are in your starting lineup; Jacobs is out after finger surgery and Marks will almost certainly miss Thursday with a concussion. ESPN projects 100.4 to 83.0 and gives you 61%, with the two byes counted as zeros.
KEI returns also start two byes — Drake London and Zach Charbonnet — so both projections will rise. The Pickens swap is worth 15.8 points by itself.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: KEI fill London's and Charbonnet's seats with Jonah Coleman (19.5) and Adonai Mitchell from their bench, and your D/ST stays at zero: a 17-point lead shrinks to a few points.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Making both swaps and filling the D/ST seat puts roughly 23 points back on your side.

doFirst.title: Start Pickens, bench Golden
doFirst.subtitle: Green Bay are on bye. 15.8 points for zero.

case.label: The problem
case.body: Matthew Golden is in a WR slot and Green Bay are on bye: 0.0 guaranteed.

case.label: The fix
case.body: George Pickens, 15.8 projected — 18 targets, 11 catches, 145 yards and three touchdowns in Week 10 (archive; FF Hound). Ferguson's knee keeps Dallas' tight end targets open (Yahoo 9 Nov), and Dallas–Tennessee is the week's 53.5-point total (FF Hound).

case.label: Why it is not a thesis
case.body: A bye is not a judgement. The projection prefers Pickens by 15.8 points over a player who cannot play.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Pickens is ruled inactive before Sunday 12:00 — then the seat goes to Rice (12.8), not Golden.

doFirst.sources: ESPN league file · archive · FF Hound · Yahoo

doFirst.title: Start Wilson, bench Rice
doFirst.subtitle: A 1.4-point coin flip: the projection decides, no thesis.

case.label: The call
case.body: Garrett Wilson 14.2 over Rashee Rice 12.8. Inside two points: a coin flip, which ESPN gets right 56% of the time (BACKTEST-2025).

case.label: The rule
case.body: Coin flips go to the projection with no thesis and no decision-log entry (STRATEGY §1).

case.label: The quarterback
case.body: Wilson's Geno Smith had ankle imaging that showed no major injury (ABC7 17 Nov); if Smith is ruled out before Sunday, check whether the projection has flipped to Rice.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Rice outscores Wilson in Week 11 (archive). Graded on the outcome only.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — free agents from Wed 02:00, Marks locks Thu 19:15
doFirst.title: Fill the D/ST seat — only if you accept dropping Marks
doFirst.subtitle: No claim: priority never resets. A free agent after 02:00 Wednesday, and the drop the brief will not fire.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The Rams are on bye and you carry no second defence: the D/ST slot scores 0.0. Every unrostered D/ST is on waivers until Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX (league file).

case.label: Why not a claim
case.body: IPADE priority never resets; STRATEGY §4 never spends it on a streamer. After 02:00 Wednesday, whatever nobody claimed is a free agent and costs nothing.

case.label: Why it is a fallback
case.body: Adding means dropping someone. Woody Marks is the only bench player whose week is already zero (concussion; Ryans does not expect him back Thursday — Forbes 16 Nov) — but your own add-thesis on him has not tripped: its live clause needs a game Marks and Montgomery both play. The runbook does not drop a player whose thesis stands, so this card is not armed.

case.label: If you choose it
case.body: After 02:00 Wednesday, add the highest-projected free-agent D/ST left — Steelers (9.0) if no one claimed them, else Jets (8.1) — and drop Marks before his Thursday 19:15 kickoff locks him.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Houston rule Marks out and Montgomery active on Wednesday's report — that ends the reason Marks was added, and the drop becomes a real recommendation.

doFirst.sources: ESPN league file · Forbes · NBC · STRATEGY §4

whatWentWrong.title: Two byes are still in the lineup
whatWentWrong.lead: Golden and the Rams D/ST both start, and Green Bay and the Rams have no game.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The lineup carried over from Week 10. It projects 100.3; the projection lineup projects 117.5 (lineup check).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Pickens and Wilson swaps above, and the D/ST fallback.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — byes are certain. Only the D/ST seat needs a decision.

whatWentWrong.title: Marks is out and Montgomery is back
whatWentWrong.lead: No practice Monday; Montgomery practised in full.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Marks took a concussion in Week 10 and did not practise Monday; Ryans does not expect him to clear for Thursday (NBC 16 Nov; Forbes 16 Nov). Montgomery, out four games, was a full participant (NBC 16 Nov).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Marks is the natural seat for a one-week D/ST — but his thesis has not tripped, so the D/ST card is a fallback, not an armed move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wednesday's Texans report ruling Marks out with Montgomery full.

worthALook.name: Omarion Hampton
worthALook.lead: 22 carries and an 81.5% carry share — on waivers here, and priority never resets.

case.label: The player
case.body: 22 carries for 105 yards and a touchdown in Week 10, an 81.5% carry share, but 2 targets; DraftSharks credits game script — the Chargers led all game and ran 27 times to 18 passes (17 Nov).

case.label: The matchup
case.body: The Jets allow the 10th-most points to running backs (DraftSharks 17 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: At 10.0 projected he would not start over Taylor (16.4), Tuten (16.9) or Gordon (13.8), and a claim drops you to last for the season. A bench back is not the one.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jacobs' return slipping past Week 13, or a Taylor or Tuten injury — then he would start immediately, which is the only case STRATEGY §4 spends priority on.
